top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and its active form is a mature, mechanistically stable discovery: proglucagon processing, the insulinotropic action of GLP-1(7-36) and incretin secretion in humans explain why degradation-resistant agonists work, and independent trials have confirmed the effect on glycaemia, weight and cardiorenal outcomes. The achievement fits one citation, and the Drucker, Holst and Mojsov allocation covers secretion and action in humans, receptor and tissue biology, and the active form without a fourth name. No award is the weaker outcome because the discovery meets the maturity and impact tests.
